title: Machine Condition Monitoring Software — Overview and definition
t: Machine Condition Monitoring Software — Overview and definition
description: Watches vibration, temperature, and current to catch machine faults early.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Watches vibration, temperature, and current to catch machine faults early. Machine condition monitoring software continuously acquires vibration, temperature, acoustic, and motor-current data, extracts fault features (bearing frequencies, imbalance, misalignment), and trends them against ISO 10816/20816 zones. Real implementations include SKF @ptitude, Emerson AMS, and open Python pipelines. It raises work orders before faults become failures.

ISO zone alarming with trend extrapolation

description: Watches vibration, temperature, and current to catch machine faults early.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. How Machine Condition Monitoring Software is actually implemented. Machine condition monitoring software continuously acquires vibration, temperature, acoustic, and motor-current data, extracts fault features (bearing frequencies, imbalance, misalignment), and trends them against ISO 10816/20816 zones. Real implementations combine Web dashboards, mobile apps, CMMS integration with DAQ hardware, a time-series database, bearing databases. The implementation is verified by Verify on a seeded bearing-fault rig: the software flags the outer-race fault 6 weeks before failure with no false alarms on healthy machines

body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Machine Condition Monitoring Software, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Vibration feature extraction: RMS, kurtosis, envelope spectra). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Vibration feature extraction: RMS, kurtosis, envelope spectra and Bearing and gear fault-frequency matching. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Vibration test analysis software) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
